positions.title: Development Expert of Information System - Real Time Market Access
positions.description:
- Provide performance analysis, and expert insights to the Production and Business partners.
- RedHat-certified for expertise in Performance Tuning.
- Technologies watch on high performance computing and Electronic Market Making. 
- Development, Optimization and Stabilization of market access connectors to various european exchanges.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Technically coach new collaborators and provide design review.
•  Bridge the gap between Marseilles development team and Velizy validation team.
•  Development of LTE features for LTE Mobipass.
•  Extension of full stack capacity for LTE Mobipass.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Interpersonal Skills · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Analytics · Python (Programming Language) · Datasets · Software Development · Data Visualization · Mathematics · Research Skills · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• R&D of Mobility Management protocols for the future Mobile Internet.
• Innovation on Scalable Proxy Mobile IPv6 for Wireless Mesh Networks. 
• Publication of 9 international conference papers and 3 research reports.
• Integration and Evaluation of Proxy Mobile IPv6 protocol in the OpenAirInterface platform.
• Projects: FP6 MULTINET, FP7 CHORIST, RNRT AIRNET, MAXSSIMM (Project kick-off).
• Supervision of master projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Interpersonal Skills · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Analytics · Data Visualization · Mathematics · Research Skills · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Master Intern
positions.description:
• Trends watch on the 3GPP standardization process of Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBMS), in the scope of the European FP6 DAIDALOS project.
• Integration of MBMS into the OpenAirInterface platform
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Interpersonal Skills · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Analytics · Data Visualization · Research Skills · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Part-time R&D Engineer
positions.description:
• Took a leading role in the project of mobile software and multi-player mobile game development
• Archived the top ten prize for "Horserace", a multiplayer mobile game over GPRS, in Vietnam Mobile Games 2004 organized by Samsung Vietnam.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Interpersonal Skills · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Analytics · Information Technology · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Engineer Intern & Collaborator
positions.description:
• Analyzed and documented the Inter-Bank Payment System (IBPS).
• Designed and implemented a secured model for B2B eCommerce on BEA Tuxedo application server.
• Finished the graduate thesis on “Key Establishment Protocols” for obtaining the Engineer degree.
